reference_rule: exactly three long approximately 0.4 A initial 0.04C discharge segments per cell; duration >=72000 s; capacity >=8 Ah; current within 10% of 0.4 A
validation_rule: positive-current full discharges at approximately 2, 5, or 10 A only; assigned to 0.2C, 0.5C, 1C; current within 10%; capacity >=65% Q_ref; S5 valid >=95%; min voltage <=3.05 V
soc_definition: SOC(t)=1-cumulative positive-current discharge Ah / Q_ref from the start of each frozen validation discharge; no end-point rescaling
sensor_mainline: S5 relative Bragg shift: S5_rel(t)=S5(t)-S5(start of current frozen discharge)
